Obligations i0,i1,i2,i3,i4,i5,i6 have exact model facts showing missing actions, missing effects or missing guard, establishing first violated-obligation readings despite predicate/backend unsupported status for several. Obligations i11 and i12 lack deterministic executable predicates and exact binding, so the dossiers cannot decide the state-after-stimulus target and initial entry respectively; grounding remains unresolved with no competent defeater supported by supplied evidence.

issues.basis: NL5 segment, contract NL-CONTRACT-NL5-DISPLAY-1, inspection_equivalent_facts.states and actions inventory empty, fcstm_model state ReadytoCook line 15
issues.expected: ReadytoCook state executes action cooking time is displayed and updated
issues.observed: Closed FCSTM model inventory contains state ReadytoCook with no lifecycle actions; reference inspection facts report zero actions
issues.reason: Contract NL5-DISPLAY-1 requires a state_action in ReadytoCook but the closed model provides no action_fact for that state
issues.requirement_quote: In the DoorShutWithItem state, opening the door transitions the system back to DoorOpenWithItem, while entering cooking time takes the system to ReadytoCook, where the cooking time is displayed and updated.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Display/update could be considered implicit behavior of the ReadytoCook state name
issues.title: ReadytoCook missing cooking time display/update action

issues.basis: NL7 segment, contract NL-CONTRACT-NL7-TIMERSTART-1, inspection_equivalent_facts.states for Cooking line 16, fcstm_model
issues.expected: Cooking state entry action timer starts
issues.observed: State Cooking exists in closed model with no recorded entry action; inspection_equivalent_facts shows no actions
issues.reason: Contract NL7-TIMERSTART-1 requires entry action timer starts on Cooking but no action_fact is present in the closed model
issues.requirement_quote: When the Start action is performed in ReadytoCook, the system transitions to the Cooking state, where the timer starts.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Timer start could be modeled as an implicit effect of the Start transition
issues.title: Cooking missing entry timer starts action

issues.basis: NL6 segment, contract NL-CONTRACT-NL6-EFFECT-1, inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions line 27 effects []
issues.expected: Transition ReadytoCook -> DoorShutWithItem on Cancel includes effect cancel or update cooking time
issues.observed: Transition transition:line:27 has triggers [Cancel] and empty effects list in inspection_equivalent_facts
issues.reason: Contract requires an effect on cooking time for the Cancel transition from ReadytoCook, but the closed model transition carries no effect
issues.requirement_quote: In the ReadytoCook state, if the Cancel action is performed, the system returns to DoorShutWithItem, canceling or updating the cooking time. If the door is opened, the system transitions to DoorOpenWithItem.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: State return to DoorShutWithItem may imply cooking time cancellation
issues.title: Cancel from ReadytoCook missing cooking time cancel/update effect

issues.basis: NL8 segment, contract NL-CONTRACT-NL8-STOP-TIMER-EFFECT-1, inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions line 30 effects []
issues.expected: Transition Cooking -> DoorOpenWithItem on Door Opened includes effect stops timer
issues.observed: Transition transition:line:30 has triggers [Door_Opened] and empty effects in inspection_equivalent_facts
issues.reason: Contract requires timer stop effect for the door-open transition out of Cooking, but the closed model transition has no effect recorded
issues.requirement_quote: In the Cooking state, opening the door stops the timer and the system transitions to DoorOpenWithItem, while if the timer expires, the system moves to DoorShutWithItem. A Cancel action transitions the system back to ReadytoCook.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Stopping timer could be conflated with the state change to DoorOpenWithItem
issues.title: Cooking door open missing stop timer effect
